title: A Noise is Worth Diffusion Guidance
tldr_zh: LoRA 噪声精炼器把高斯噪声映到免引导噪声空间，SD2.1 无 CFG 达 CFG 质量，FID 11.39 vs 13.38，约 2× 快
tldr_en: NoiseRefine learns a one-shot noise-to-guidance-free-noise map via multistep score distillation; SD2.1 without CFG matches CFG quality at 2x speed.
key_numbers: MS-COCO 30K: FID 42.71 (Gaussian, no guidance) / 11.39 (refined, no guidance) / 13.38 (Gaussian + guidance); IS 20.86 / 35.73 / 37.64 (Table 2)
Inference 1.357 s / 1.504 s / 2.589 s per image at 20 steps on RTX 3090 (Table 2)
User study 45 participants x 30 pairs: quality 53.96% prefer refined noise over Gaussian+CFG (Table 4)
LoRA on pretrained SD2.1 vs UNet from scratch: FID 13.74 vs 37.87 (Table 5)
Only the (0, 0.1) normalized low-frequency band of refined noise carries the layout (Fig. 20)
Training: 50K self-generated pairs, 8 A100-40GB, batch 4, 39k steps (Appendix D.2)
